title: Constructible sheaves of modules on a qcqs scheme: global partition iff affine-local (Stacks 095E)
statement: Let $T$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_T$-modules on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. The following are equivalent: (1) (Stacks 03RW(3)) for every affine open $U\subseteq T$ there is a finite partition $U=\coprod_iU_i$ of $U$ into pairwise disjoint locally closed subsets $U_i$ which are constructible subsets of $U$ [def-weil-constructible-subset], such that, giving $U_i$ its reduced induced subscheme structure with immersion $u_i:U_i\to T$, the inverse image $u_i^{-1}\mathcal F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is finite locally constant as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]; (2) there is an open covering $T=\bigcup_jV_j$ such that each restriction $\mathcal F|_{V_j}$ satisfies (1) on the scheme $V_j$; (3) $\mathcal F$ is constructible in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] (a finite partition of $T$ by constructible locally closed subsets with immersed schemes on whose inverse images $\mathcal F$ is finite locally constant).

source.place: Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated), the statement for sheaves of Lambda-modules with Lambda Noetherian ('A similar statement holds'), here Lambda finite, and its proof; Stacks' condition 'of finite type and locally constant' in 03RW(3) is, for Lambda finite, the finite-locally-constant condition used here by lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values ((1) iff (3)); Definition 03RW (definition-constructible) and the paragraph before it (reduced induced structure, topological invariance 03SI); uses Topology Lemma 09Y4 (topology-lemma-constructible-partition-refined-by-stratification), Topology Lemma 'quasi-compact-open-immersion-constructible-image', Properties Lemma 'locally-constructible'.

proof.text: For (1) implies (2), take the singleton open cover consisting of the whole scheme. For an affine open U of this member, its image W in T is affine. Transport the witnessing stratification of W along the inverse of the canonical isomorphism U ≅ W. Keep the same domains, compose their immersions with this isomorphism, and use isoImage_inv_ι to identify the composite into T. The domains remain reduced.

proof.text: Use IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.upperStar, whose two fields are the pullback stability of locally constant sheaves [lemma-constructible-pullback-locally-constant] and finite sheaves [lemma-constructible-pullback-finite]. The comparison Etale.upperStarComp [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] and isomorphism invariance [lemma-constructible-iso-invariance] identify an iterated pullback with pullback along the composite. All comparisons take place in ModuleCat, so no additional scalar-naturality argument or restriction comparison is necessary.

proof.text: Under (2), for every point choose a member V of the cover and an affine neighbourhood U of that point in V using [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. Its image W in T is affine. Transport the partition of U to W along the canonical isomorphism U ≅ W, keeping its domains and composing the immersions with the isomorphism. The equation isoImage_hom_ι identifies the composite into T, hence preserves the local finite-constancy hypotheses. Apply isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover and index the resulting finite set by Fin n. This construction allows n = 0 on the empty scheme.

proof.text: Apply exists_global_stratification_factoring_local [lem-weil-pbc-etale-stratification-local-gluing-core] to the finite affine cover and the transported stratifications. For every global stratum, pull back its selected local finite system along the actual factorization q given by that theorem. Step 2 and q followed by the local composite immersion equal to the global immersion give finite local constancy. Apply the first equivalence of finite_locally_constant_module_values_iff [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values] to obtain the required finite-value datum. The global stratification therefore witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf].

proof.text: Under (3), pull back its stratification along the affine-open immersion U → T using Stratification.pullback [lemma-constructible-pullback-stratification]. This already supplies constructible locally closed strata. For every domain Z of this partition, replace it by the explicitly constructed nilradical subscheme Z_red and compose its immersion with the reduction inclusion. Reducedness and the full image of the reduction are the corresponding clauses of [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-universal-homeomorphism], implemented by isReduced_nilradical_subscheme, range_subschemeι, and support_nilradical. Thus the original partition and its constructibility remain unchanged. Convert the given finite-value data to finite local constancy using [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values]. Step 2 pulls it back along the first projection of the base-change square and then along the reduction inclusion. The pullback condition identifies the composite into T. This proves (1), including empty strata, without immersion independence or any claim that containment of images implies factorization.
